scope: public view metadata only; no customer rows

views.definition:
SELECT id AS booking_id,
    player_team_name AS player_name,
    player_phone,
    stadium_name,
    total_price AS original_amount,
    round(total_price * 0.97 - 3::numeric, 2) AS refund_amount,
    payment_transaction_id AS paymob_reference,
    created_at AS booking_date,
    updated_at AS cancellation_date
   FROM bookings
  WHERE status = 'cancelled'::text AND is_paid = true AND payment_status = 'paid'::text AND payment_method <> 'cash'::text;

SELECT owner_id,
    stadium_name,
    count(id) AS total_matches,
    sum(total_price) AS total_revenue,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN payment_method = 'cash'::text THEN total_price
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END) AS cash_collected_by_owner,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN payment_method <> 'cash'::text THEN total_price
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END) AS online_collected_by_vsp,
    round(sum(COALESCE(platform_fee, vsp_commission, 0::numeric)), 2) AS vsp_commission,
    round(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN payment_method <> 'cash'::text THEN total_price
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END) - sum(COALESCE(platform_fee, vsp_commission, 0::numeric)), 2) AS net_balance
   FROM bookings b
  WHERE status = 'completed'::text AND match_result_status <> 'disputed'::text
  GROUP BY owner_id, stadium_name;

SELECT id,
    owner_id,
    name,
    location,
    governorate,
    price_per_hour,
    base_price,

    lat,

    created_at,
    updated_at,
    needs_deposit,
    deposit_amount,
    city,
    description,
    features,
    players_per_team,
    total_field_capacity,
    is_deleted_by_owner,
    maintenance_until,
    maintenance_reason,
    last_emergency_closure_at
   FROM stadiums;

SELECT id,
    name,
    phone,
    verification_status,
    subscription_plan,
    trial_ends_at,
    subscription_expires_at,
    total_platform_fees,
        CASE
            WHEN subscription_plan = 'pro'::text AND subscription_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND subscription_expires_at > now() THEN 'active_paid'::text
            WHEN trial_ends_at IS NOT NULL AND trial_ends_at > now() THEN 'active_trial'::text
            ELSE 'active_free'::text
        END AS effective_status,
        CASE
            WHEN subscription_plan = 'pro'::text AND subscription_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND subscription_expires_at > now() THEN 3
            WHEN trial_ends_at IS NOT NULL AND trial_ends_at > now() THEN 3
            ELSE 1
        END AS max_stadiums_allowed
   FROM users u
  WHERE role = 'owner'::text AND (id = auth.uid() OR is_admin_or_cofounder(auth.uid()) OR (CURRENT_USER = ANY (ARRAY['postgres'::name, 'service_role'::name])));

SELECT code,
    name_ar,
    name_en,
    description_ar,
    description_en,
    monthly_price,
    yearly_price,
    trial_days,
    max_stadiums,
    features,
    display_order
   FROM subscription_plans
  WHERE is_active = true;

SELECT id,
    name,

    primary_color,
    secondary_color,
    captain_image_url,
    beaten_opponents,
    played_opponents,
    unlocked_badges,
    governorate,
    sport_type,
    price_per_person,
    date,
    stadium,
    captain_name,
    is_official,
    attendance_score,
    verified_badge,
    has_1v1_champion,
    bio
   FROM teams;

SELECT championship_id,
    team_name,
    count(*) AS clean_sheets_count
   FROM ( SELECT tournament_matches.championship_id,
            tournament_matches.home_team_name AS team_name
           FROM tournament_matches
          WHERE (tournament_matches.status = 'completed'::text OR tournament_matches.is_completed = true) AND tournament_matches.away_score = 0 AND tournament_matches.home_team_name IS NOT NULL AND tournament_matches.home_team_name <> ''::text
        UNION ALL
         SELECT tournament_matches.championship_id,
            tournament_matches.away_team_name AS team_name
           FROM tournament_matches
          WHERE (tournament_matches.status = 'completed'::text OR tournament_matches.is_completed = true) AND tournament_matches.home_score = 0 AND tournament_matches.away_team_name IS NOT NULL AND tournament_matches.away_team_name <> ''::text) clean_matches
  GROUP BY championship_id, team_name
  ORDER BY (count(*)) DESC;

SELECT id,
    created_by_user_id,
    owner_id,
    stadium_name,
    start_time,
    end_time,
    total_price,
    payment_method,
    payment_status,
    status,
    refund_amount,
    refund_transaction_id,
    refunded_at,
    refund_payment_method,
    cancelled_at,
    platform_fee,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(refund_payment_method, payment_method) = ANY (ARRAY['wallet'::text, 'vodafone_cash'::text, 'instapay'::text]) THEN 'wallet'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(refund_payment_method, payment_method) = ANY (ARRAY['card'::text, 'paymob'::text, 'online'::text]) THEN 'card'::text
            ELSE 'cash'::text
        END AS refund_channel,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(refund_payment_method, payment_method) = ANY (ARRAY['wallet'::text, 'vodafone_cash'::text, 'instapay'::text]) THEN 'minutes'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(refund_payment_method, payment_method) = ANY (ARRAY['card'::text, 'paymob'::text, 'online'::text]) THEN '3-5_business_days'::text
            ELSE 'immediate'::text
        END AS refund_eta,
    COALESCE(refund_transaction_id, payment_reference, paymob_transaction_id) AS display_refund_ref
   FROM bookings b
  WHERE status = 'cancelled'::text AND payment_status = 'refunded'::text;

SELECT u.id AS owner_id,
    u.name AS owner_name,
    u.phone AS owner_phone,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM bookings b
          WHERE b.owner_id = u.id AND b.status <> 'cancelled'::text) AS active_bookings_count,
    (fs.fs ->> 'total_online_revenue'::text)::numeric AS total_online_revenue,
    (fs.fs ->> 'completed_online_revenue'::text)::numeric AS completed_online_revenue,
    (fs.fs ->> 'escrow_online_revenue'::text)::numeric AS escrow_online_revenue,
    (fs.fs ->> 'total_gateway_fees'::text)::numeric AS total_gateway_fees,
    (fs.fs ->> 'total_vsp_commission'::text)::numeric AS total_platform_commission,
    (fs.fs ->> 'cash_revenue'::text)::numeric AS total_pitch_cash_revenue,
    (fs.fs ->> 'accumulated_cash_debt'::text)::numeric AS accumulated_cash_debt,
    (fs.fs ->> 'debt_limit'::text)::numeric AS debt_limit,
    (fs.fs ->> 'is_debt_blocked'::text)::boolean AS is_debt_blocked,
    (fs.fs ->> 'total_withdrawn'::text)::numeric AS total_withdrawn,
    (fs.fs ->> 'pending_payouts'::text)::numeric AS pending_payouts,
    (fs.fs ->> 'available_balance'::text)::numeric AS available_balance
   FROM users u
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL get_owner_financial_summary(u.id) fs(fs)
  WHERE u.role = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text, 'co_founder'::text, 'cofounder'::text, 'super_admin'::text]);
